notes: Two-stage pipeline. Stage 1: studio product shot via Flux 2 Pro (text-to-image, white seamless backdrop).
Stage 2: two scene shots via Seedream 4.5 (image-to-image), each using the Stage 1 studio shot as a reference image so the same product appears in the lifestyle scene.

v1.1.0: introduced locked camera_conventions per category. Per-product 'prompt' fields no longer contain camera/angle language; the generator composes: studio_style + camera_conventions[camera_category] + product 'prompt'. This guarantees consistent azimuth/elevation/distance/framing across all SKUs in a category.

anchors.studio_style_prefix: Three-quarter angle product photograph, camera angled per the camera position rule below, NOT a straight-on frontal shot.
anchors.studio_style: Professional product photography, photorealistic, single object catalog shot. Lighting: soft directional studio key light from upper-left, gentle fill from the right, single soft contact shadow directly under the object on a pure white seamless backdrop, no rim light, no kicker, no second shadow. Framing: object centered horizontally, vertically positioned so the contact shadow sits at 60% from the top of the frame so the object appears slightly below center, 10% margin on the left and right edges, no cropping of any part of the object. Lens: shot on a 50mm full-frame equivalent lens at f/8 aperture so the entire object is in sharp focus including its base or legs. Background: pure white seamless backdrop, no text, no watermark, no logo, no other props.
anchors.studio_style_suffix: Important reminder: the camera is angled three-quarter view as specified above, NOT a straight-on frontal shot.
anchors.studio_negative: text, watermark, logo, signage, busy background, props, plants, flowers, multiple objects, lifestyle setting, room interior, mood lighting, dramatic shadows, rim light, multiple shadows, cluttered, cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi look, oversaturated, hdr
anchors.scene_style: Photorealistic interior photography, scandinavian aesthetic, soft natural light from a window, warm tones, shallow depth of field, magazine-quality composition, no text
anchors.scene_negative: text, watermark, logo, cartoon, illustration, 3d render, oversaturated, hdr, harsh shadows, multiple of the same product

coffee_table._description: Low rectangular furniture, view tilted slightly down so the tabletop is readable.
coffee_table.language: Camera position: tabletop level plus 30 centimeters of additional height (so the camera looks slightly down onto the tabletop and roughly 30 percent of the table surface is visible). Camera azimuth: 30 degrees to the left of straight-on front so the right-hand short edge faces the camera. Distance: object fills 75 percent of the frame width.

dining_table._description: Larger rectangular furniture, slightly higher angle than coffee tables.
dining_table.language: Camera position: tabletop level plus 50 centimeters of additional height. Camera azimuth: 30 degrees to the left of straight-on front. Distance: object fills 85 percent of the frame width.

dining_chair._description: Single chair, eye-level with the seat.
dining_chair.language: Camera position: level with the seat surface (approximately 45 centimeters above the floor). Camera azimuth: 30 degrees to the left of straight-on front so the seat and back-curve are both readable. Distance: object fills 75 percent of the frame height with generous floor space below the legs.

lounge_chair_or_sofa._description: Upholstered seating, seat-level plus a touch.
lounge_chair_or_sofa.language: Camera position: seat-cushion level plus 20 centimeters of additional height. Camera azimuth: 30 degrees to the left of straight-on front so the upholstery on the seat and back is clearly visible. Distance: object fills 80 percent of the frame width.

curved_sofa._description: Curved sofa needs higher camera so the curve reads.
curved_sofa.language: Camera position: seat-cushion level plus 50 centimeters of additional height so the curve of the sofa is clearly readable from above. Camera azimuth: 30 degrees to the left of straight-on front. Distance: object fills 85 percent of the frame width with the entire curved silhouette visible.

bed._description: Bed with headboard, mattress level + 40 cm.
bed.language: Camera position: mattress level plus 40 centimeters of additional height. Camera azimuth: 30 degrees to the left of straight-on front so the headboard and the long side of the bed are both readable. Distance: object fills 85 percent of the frame width with the entire headboard fully in frame.

nightstand._description: Small upright furniture, eye-level with the top.
nightstand.language: Camera position: level with the top surface of the nightstand (approximately 55 centimeters above the floor). Camera azimuth: 30 degrees to the left of straight-on front so the drawer fronts and pulls are clearly readable without distortion. Distance: object fills 70 percent of the frame height.

wardrobe._description: Tall furniture; less aggressive azimuth so it doesn't loom.
wardrobe.language: Camera position: human eye level, 160 centimeters above the floor. Camera azimuth: 20 degrees to the left of straight-on front (less rotation than smaller furniture so the wardrobe does not loom). Distance: object fills 90 percent of the frame height with the entire wardrobe from plinth to top fully in frame.

floor_lamp._description: Tall thin object — keep mostly frontal so silhouette reads.
floor_lamp.language: Camera position: human eye level, 160 centimeters above the floor. Camera azimuth: 15 degrees to the left of straight-on front (subtle, mostly frontal so the lamp's silhouette reads cleanly). Distance: object fills 90 percent of the frame height.

outdoor_lamp.language: Camera position: human eye level, 160 centimeters above the floor. Camera azimuth: 15 degrees to the left of straight-on front. Distance: object fills 85 percent of the frame height.

pendant_light._description: Hanging object, camera below the shade looking slightly up.
pendant_light.language: Camera position: 120 centimeters above the floor, looking slightly upward toward the pendant which is suspended approximately 180 centimeters above the floor by a slim cord disappearing into the top edge of the frame. Camera azimuth: 20 degrees to the left of straight-on front. Distance: object fills 70 percent of the frame height with ample headroom of pure white above the pendant.
pendant_light.framing_override: Vertical framing: the pendant hangs in the upper-middle of the frame with the cord rising into the top edge of the frame, the contact shadow rule does not apply because the object is suspended.

table_lamp._description: Small upright object on a stand.
table_lamp.language: Camera position: level with the top of the lampshade (approximately 50 centimeters above the table surface, total height 120 centimeters above the floor). Camera azimuth: 30 degrees to the left of straight-on front. Distance: object fills 75 percent of the frame height.

vase_or_decor_object._description: Small symmetric objects look best near-frontal with subtle rotation.
vase_or_decor_object.language: Camera position: eye level with the mid-height of the object. Camera azimuth: 20 degrees to the left of straight-on front (subtle rotation for a symmetric object). Distance: object fills 80 percent of the frame height.

wall_mirror._description: Wall-mounted symmetric object, very slight azimuth so frame depth reads.
wall_mirror.language: Camera position: human eye level, 150 centimeters above the floor, level with the centre of the mirror as if it is hung on a wall. Camera azimuth: 10 degrees to the left of straight-on front (very subtle, just enough that the frame's depth is visible). Distance: object fills 80 percent of the frame height. The mirror surface should reflect a soft neutral light grey so it does not become a distracting element.
wall_mirror.framing_override: The contact shadow rule does not apply because the mirror is wall-mounted; instead show a soft cast shadow on the wall behind and to the lower-right of the mirror.

wall_art.language: Camera position: human eye level, 150 centimeters above the floor, perfectly level with the centre of the artwork as if it is hung on a wall. Camera azimuth: 0 degrees, perfectly straight-on front, no rotation, no perspective distortion. Distance: framed artwork fills 70 percent of the frame.
wall_art.framing_override: The contact shadow rule does not apply because the artwork is wall-mounted; instead show a soft cast shadow on the wall behind and slightly below the frame to imply the wall.

wall_art_trio._description: Three framed prints arranged in a row, frontal.
wall_art_trio.language: Camera position: human eye level, 150 centimeters above the floor, perfectly level with the centre of the middle frame. Camera azimuth: 0 degrees, perfectly straight-on front. Distance: the three frames together fill 80 percent of the frame width, evenly spaced in a horizontal row.
wall_art_trio.framing_override: The contact shadow rule does not apply; show a soft cast shadow on the wall behind and slightly below each frame.

outdoor_set._description: Set with multiple chairs around a table; needs higher camera so back chairs read.
outdoor_set.language: Camera position: tabletop level plus 100 centimeters of additional height (a noticeably elevated angle so all four chairs around the table are clearly visible). Camera azimuth: 15 degrees to the left of straight-on front (less rotation than usual so the back two chairs are not occluded by the table). Distance: the entire set fills 85 percent of the frame width with the table centered and all four chairs fully in frame.
